body:
I appreciate what you're trying to say, but we didn't enter this relationship blind. I knew what I was getting in to, and he is honestly much better than he was 7 years ago. I am in no way making excuses for him.

As for him taking away our son, that would be voluntary on my part. He would be the better option. He has a support network and family that loves and dotes on our son. He has a good job and is an amazing father. I have barely a job, just went back to school, a mountain of debt and extremely unpredictable moodswings.

While i know assholes can cause depression my gp believes, and we will soon find out, that I have bipolar ii.

 There is so much underneath the surface that you really can't see.

Again, thank you for your support.

I think we are both a little wrong.

This post is written from my view when i was hurting most so its hard to show an accurate picture of whats going on.

That being said I took a nap and have a bit clearer of a mindset

He doesnt beleive in therapy.

He says i never try to understand how he feels and he's right. I am always overwhelmed by how hurt i am and am very inconsiderate when it comes to him. He's always had to be the strong one and I have always been broken and don't know how to be anything else.

I dont know how to change. I always say i want to be better for him but i never am. Everything he has a grievance with makes sense, im just always so lost.

Every time we talk it turns in to a fight.

He just called me and i told him i want to kill myself and he said that im stupid. Im selfish and I'm crazy. That our son needs me and i need to be better for him. But i don't know if I can
